eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 11:37 AM on AUG 28, 2020 Effective until 9:37 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Phoenix Police Department is looking for Jane Jansol Sebille, an eighty one year old white female. Last seen on foot near scottsdale road and Bell Road in Phoenix, Arizona. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
